# Until

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Loops](Language-Features-Loops)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Repeat
statements
Until condition
```

## Description

Ends a [Repeat](Repeat) loop. The loop goes around again while the condition is false.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
n = 0
Repeat
	n = n + 1
Until n = 3
Print n
```

```text
3
```
